images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of Physis-Lang. Existing approaches treat language mainly as a conditioning interface and introduce physical knowledge through separate visual, latent, numerical, or planning-based signals. Physis-Lang instead treats physical language as a shared and optimizable representation: an agentic loop evaluates and refines physical descriptions, language-guided retrieval expands the training data toward missing physical processes, and the evolved language supervises training and guides inference toward physically plausible video generation.

Figure 3:Overview of our physics-aware critic and physics caption benchmark. The critic evaluates generated captions from complementary precision and recall perspectives by verifying atomic claims against the input video and measuring the coverage of human-curated physical assertions.
